name: zerodahero
description: Zack Teska's general-purpose agent skills, as an installable Claude Code plugin.

plugins.name: zerodahero-skills
plugins.description: General-purpose agent skills for code review and naming: a branch reviewer, a second-opinion reviewer for other harnesses, and a domain-term glossary check.

plugins.name: zerodahero-plan-capture
plugins.description: Copies every plan you approve into .claude/plan/ in the repo, numbered, with current.md pointing at the latest.
